title: The Final Orbit
author: Xanthe Almeida
blurb: Mara Fairweather, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
